A fix is on the way: https://github.com/etcd-io/etcd/pull/11564

issue_context.title: Promote GlobalAccess for GCE Internal Loadbalancers to GA
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please only use this template for submitting enhancement requests -->

**What would you like to be added**:
Global Access for GCE internal load-balancers allows clients to access backends of the load-balancer from any region. The feature is already using GCE compute beta API. This is to bump the API to use GA version.

**Why is this needed**:
To promote the feature to use more stable GCE compute API version(GA)

/sig network
/area platform/gce

review_comments: Trying to understand the logic - isn't `old.IPAddress == new.IPAddress` sufficient?

This logic was introduced in #46663 (Search for `FwdRuleEqual` in `gce_loadbalancer_internal.go`)

@prameshj brought this up as well, we are still figuring out the thought process behind this logic. Probably, I will fix this in a follow up PR.

It seems fine to replace with just "old.IPAddress == new.IPAddress". I am thinking the `new.IPAddress == ""` is to disallow change when IP assignment drops to empty if network/subnetwork have not changed.

I can't see why `old.IPAddress== ""` needs to be here. We were thinking of fixing in a follow-up PR so that in can be easily reverted without reverting the GA api change.
